name: claudesign
description: Design toolkit in three skills: web-design (direction, DESIGN.md tokens, landing pages, anti-AI-slop build, rendered checks, site reviews), ux-design (heuristic critique, WCAG 2.2 audits, microcopy, interaction states, research and journey maps) and naming (metaphor-driven names with availability checks).

interface.longDescription: web-design picks a direction, writes DESIGN.md and tokens, builds pages with honest copy and checks them rendered at phone, tablet and desktop; ux-design runs heuristic critiques, WCAG 2.2 audits, microcopy and research plans with severity-ordered output; naming finds product and project names through metaphor territories with real availability checks. Personal toolkit maintained by travnie.
defaultPrompt: Design a landing page for this app and write the DESIGN.md first
Audit this page against WCAG 2.2 AA
Find a name for my RSS reader app
